hooks.name: Words check on save
hooks.description: Blocks words and patterns that safety.md and tech.md forbid: calling Aizhan Li a psychologist or therapist, innerHTML assignments, and autoplay sound. Runs a plain grep, no agent call.

action.command: if [ -d src ]; then f=src; [ -f index.html ] && f='src index.html'; if grep -rnE '[Pp]sychologist|[Tt]herapist|\.innerHTML *=|autoplay' $f; then echo 'Words check failed: see safety.md and tech.md'; exit 1; else echo 'Words check passed'; fi; else echo 'No src yet, skipping'; fi
